title: (RHBA-2020:5078) s390utils bug fix update
portal_summary: An update for s390utils is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for IBM System z (Structure A)|7|s390x
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL-Alt-7.6 - zkey: Fix listing of keys on file systems reporting DT_UNKNOWN. (s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#1792954)
